description: Institutional profiles for one or more school IDs. Accepts up to 1,000 elements, deduplicates normalized IDs, serves the first 100 distinct IDs, and reports missing and unprocessed IDs separately. Use scorecard_compare_schools for comparisons. Custom fields return requested paths and their JSON values in selected_fields, absent paths in absent_fields, and real identity; default profiles include costs, admissions, outcomes, aid, and completion rates.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated list of custom field paths from scorecard_list_fields. Overrides the default field set.

anyOf.description: Base-10 school ID resolving to a positive safe integer; whitespace, leading zeros, plus, decimal, and exponent forms are accepted.
Up to 1,000 elements; first 100 distinct IDs served, excess reported separately.
Base-10 school ID resolving to a positive safe integer; whitespace, leading zeros, plus, decimal, and exponent forms are accepted.

id.description: Positive safe integer school ID or up to 1,000 raw elements. First 100 distinct normalized IDs served; discover IDs with scorecard_search_schools.

name: scorecard_get_school

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_conflict`: The provider reported a request conflict. `api_invalid_params`: Provider rejected a query parameter. `api_validation`: A meaningful selector or provider value is invalid. `api_unauthorized`: The provider rejected the API credentials. `api_forbidden`: The provider denied access. `api_rate_limited`: The provider throttled the request. `api_timeout`: The provider exchange exceeded its deadline. `api_not_found`: The provider endpoint returned HTTP 404. `api_invalid_request`: The provider returned an unexpected redirect. `api_internal`: The provider returned an unclassified HTTP response. `not_found`: None of the requested school IDs returned a record. `api_error`: The College Scorecard API returned an error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

missing_ids.description: Processed distinct IDs with no returned record.

notice.description: Warning when some requested IDs returned no record.

schools.description: Full profiles for the requested school(s).

absent_fields.description: Requested paths absent from this provider response; not proof of invalid syntax.

cost_of_attendance.description: Total cost of attendance per year.

federal_loan_rate.description: Share of students receiving federal loans (0–1).

men_only.description: Whether the institution is men-only. Absent when unknown.

ownership.description: Control type: Public, Private nonprofit, or For-profit.

pell_grant_rate.description: Share of students receiving Pell grants (0–1).

repayment_progress_3yr.description: Share of borrowers paying down principal (declining loan balance) 3 years after entering repayment (0–1).

selected_fields.description: Requested JSON values, including null; nested program leaves retain the provider parent subtree and array positions.

women_only.description: Whether the institution is women-only. Absent when unknown.

unprocessed_ids.description: Distinct IDs beyond the 100-ID serving cap, in caller order.
